note: Byte offsets that no enum registry describes. Hand-maintained, pinned by ci/test_pico_binary_api.py and web/test/decode.test.ts against fixtures the Python codec produced. Source for both web/src/api/layout.ts and the served /api/schema.json.

bmb1_envelope.description: BMB1 message header, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_header, format >4sBBHIQQB3s

bmcu_frame_prefix.description: BMCU_FRAME payload prefix before the verbatim link wire frame, write_bmcu_frame format >QH

link_wire.description: BMCU Link frame, pico/bmcu_link.py encode_frame. Note the endianness change: sequence and CRC are little-endian while every BMB1 field above is big-endian.

status_payload.description: kind 2 STATUS, BMCUMonitor._decode_status. Absolute offset inside a BMB1 BMCU_FRAME payload is bmcu_frame_prefix.size + link_wire.header_size + offset.

fields.name: crc_error
fields.note: BMCU side, compare with the Pico decoder counters to tell direction

fields.name: inserted_mask
fields.note: per-channel HARDWARE presence, latched at boot from the PULL potentiometer. Not filament.

fields.name: online_mask
fields.note: per-channel filament detection: the microswitch, gated by inserted_mask

log_payload.description: PICO_LOG payload, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_log, format >QQBBHH then three byte runs

tlv.description: Diagnostic and log-detail triplet, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_tlv

snapshot_record.description: /api/snapshot.bin record. Local diagnostic format, never sent to Bambuddy.

fields.name: record_type
fields.note: 240 is a synthetic link record, 241 a retained EVENT

fields.name: payload
fields.note: verbatim record_data for real record types, event_payload for 241, link_record for 240

link_record.description: Synthetic snapshot record 240: link state that no FULL_STATUS record carries

fields.name: tick_hz
fields.note: 0 when the BMCU has not sent HELLO

capture_record.description: /api/capture.bin record: UART bytes the decoder rejected. Local diagnostic format.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.note: capture count for that link, gaps mean older runs were overwritten

reading_notes: Endianness changes between layers. BMB1 and the local BSNP/BCAP formats are big-endian; everything inside a BMCU link frame is little-endian.

A STATUS field's absolute offset inside a BMB1 payload is bmcu_frame_prefix.size (10) + link_wire.header_size (7) + the status_payload offset. Reading a slot mask at offset 13 instead of 30 is the mistake this note exists to prevent.
inserted_mask is channel hardware presence, not filament. online_mask is filament. The web UI mislabelled this for a long time.

Compare the BMCU-reported crc_error and rx_drop in status_payload against the Pico decoder counters in diagnostic_tags: matching rates mean a shared cause, one-sided means the loss is in that direction only.
A counter that does not advance is as informative as one that does. Sample twice and report the delta with the elapsed time, not the absolute value.

thresholds.note: the durable ring size; a depth pinned here is steady state, not a stall, if LAST_ACK_WATERMARK is advancing
the 5 s log suppression hides the rate: the counter advances on every exception while only one line per window is logged
per link; healthy is zero since the DMA receive path landed
